description: This file defines a repository class for managing team features using Prisma ORM, including methods for querying, updating, and checking feature access with recursive hierarchy support.

classes.name: PrismaTeamFeatureRepository
classes.description: Implements the ITeamFeatureRepository interface to handle team feature data operations via Prisma ORM.

methods.name: findByTeamIdAndFeatureId
methods.description: Fetches a specific team feature by team ID and feature ID.

methods.name: findByTeamIdsAndFeatureIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple team features for given team and feature ID arrays.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a team feature record.

methods.name: findAutoOptInByTeamId
methods.description: Checks if a team has auto opt-in enabled.

methods.name: findAutoOptInByTeamIds
methods.description: Retrieves auto opt-in status for multiple teams.

methods.name: setAutoOptIn
methods.description: Sets auto opt-in status for a team.

methods.name: checkIfTeamHasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a team or its ancestors have a specific feature enabled, using recursive SQL.

methods.name: getEnabledFeatures
methods.description: Gets all enabled features for a team as a map.

methods.name: getTeamsWithFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Lists team IDs with a specific feature enabled.
